name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.27: the machine form can set a model, and adding a machine actually creates it. Two defects found while trying to register 8626020623 as a single-door fridge. First: the add and edit machine forms had no model field, and model is the ONLY thing that makes a machine a fridge - fridgeSpec reads GR- to decide cabinets and basket count, and config carries no fridge planogram without it. Every machine added through the dashboard therefore took the handleAddMachine default of VM-WM55DL and a fridge would never have received its baskets, which is the exact failure that handler warns about in its own comment. Second, and worse: the add branch never called the backend at all. It wrote to DB and localStorage and toasted 'Machine added', so the machine existed in one browser, never reached SQLite, had no config and no key - and hydrateMachinesFromBackend deleted it again on the next refresh, since anything the backend does not return is dropped. Add now POSTs and re-hydrates from the backend's own record; an add attempted while the backend is unreachable says plainly that it will not persist rather than claiming success. Edit sends the model too, and changing a machine between coil and fridge asks first, because it changes the config served and flips stockSource. An unrecognised existing model is kept as an option so opening the edit form cannot quietly reassign it. Frontend only. Cumulative over v6.26.1.
